scripts.data:readings:apply:if-exists: if [ -f data/reading-tasks.json ]; then npm run data:readings:apply; else echo "skip: data/reading-tasks.json not found"; fi
scripts.data:convert:official: node scripts/convert-csv.mjs data/戦隊カラオケリスト.csv data/songs.json && npm run data:enrich:readings && npm run data:readings:apply:if-exists
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run data:check
scripts.deploy:data: npm run data:convert:official && npm run data:check && npm run firestore:seed
scripts.deploy:app: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
scripts.deploy:all: npm run check:all && npm run deploy:data && npm run deploy:app
scripts.local:prepare: npm run data:convert:official && npm run data:check && npm run firestore:seed
scripts.local:start:fresh: npm run local:prepare && npm run dev -- --host
